dedupe_keys.name: les ouvrages hydrauliques des bassins versants de la sarthe et de l huisne

description: LES OUVRAGES HYDRAULIQUES DES BASSINS VERSANTS DE LA SARTHE ET DE L'HUISNE is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The data on hydraulic structures are derived from field inventories carried out by the SAGE Local Water Commissions of the Sarthe Amont and Huisne basins. The hydraulic structures were inventoried in the field and positioned in an S.I.G. thanks to Scan 25, Orthophoto and GPS surveys. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "WATER WORKS IN THE SARTHE AND L’HUISNE WATERSHEDS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pré-localisation, bocage, huisne, haie, sarthe amont. The listing shows 2010-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
